title: Ashbury Rewards Member Tenure Recognition: Relocation Tenure Supplement
content:
| Whole calendar months enrolled in Ashbury Rewards by the handling date | Relocation tenure supplement |
|---|---|
| 240 or more | 7500 points |
| 120 to 239 | 5000 points |
| Fewer than 120 | None |

**Schedule note.** A member enrolled for at least two hundred and forty whole calendar months by the handling date carries a relocation tenure supplement of seven thousand five hundred points, a member enrolled for one hundred and twenty to two hundred and thirty-nine whole months carries five thousand points, and a member enrolled for fewer months carries none. The months are whole calendar months from the enrolment date on the Ashbury Rewards membership to the handling date. The supplement is added to the relocation compensation of the member's relocated reservation.

**Boundary cases (hypothetical handling date of 20 November 2026).**

| Enrolment date | Whole months | Supplement |
|---|---|---|
| 21 November 2016 | 119 | None |
| 20 November 2016 | 120 | 5000 points |
| 21 November 2006 | 239 | 5000 points |
| 20 November 2006 | 240 | 7500 points |
